```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list = ls())
```


```{r load data, warning=F, message=F}

source(here::here("0-config.R"))
source(here::here("analysis", "0-functions.R"))

df_all <- readRDS(here("data","grappe_mortality_data.rds"))

districts <- df_all %>% distinct(district) %>% pull(district)
grappes <- df_all %>% distinct(grappe) %>% pull(grappe)

# Project coordinates to UTM so distances are in meters, not degrees

df_proj <- df_all %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = global_crs) %>%
  st_transform(crs = proj_crs) %>% # UTM zone 31N, for Niger
  mutate(lon = sf::st_coordinates(.)[,1],
         lat = sf::st_coordinates(.)[,2])

dist_summ <- readRDS(here("data", "district_mortality_means.rds")) %>%
  filter(district %in% districts)
ate_preds <- readRDS(here("data", "preds_ATE.rds")) 

# Load Niger boundaries map from Humanitarian Data Exchange
# Map downloaded from https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-ner on 10 March 2026

niger_adm1 <- st_read(dsn = here("data", "ner_admin_boundaries", "ner_admin1.shp"))
niger_adm2 <- st_read(dsn = here("data", "ner_admin_boundaries", "ner_admin2.shp"))

niger_adm2_sub <- readRDS(here("data", "niger_adm2_sub.rds"))

```

```{r set up shared map attributes}

niger_adm2 <- niger_adm2 %>%
  filter(adm1_name == "Dosso") %>%
  st_make_valid()

base_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = niger_adm2, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.25) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  annotation_scale() +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Longitude") +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Latitude") +
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(0.8, 0.2),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        legend.title = element_text(hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
        legend.text = element_text(hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5))

# base_map

```

# Trial data and outcomes

## Maps of treatment assignment, follow-up and mortality outcomes

```{r map obs data, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}

tx_assign <- base_map +
  geom_point(data = df_all, aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = isTreated_child), size = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(breaks = c("Control", "Treatment"),
                     values = c("#fecd6c", "#e84d60"),
                     name = "Treatment Arm") 

person_time <- base_map +
  geom_point(data = df_all, aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = pt_year_1to59),
             alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Person-years", option = "D", direction = -1)

tx_assign | person_time

n_deaths <- base_map +
  geom_point(data = df_all, aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = n_deaths_1to59),
             alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "# deaths", option = "C", direction = -1)

n_deaths_per1000 <- base_map +
  geom_point(data = df_all, aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = deaths_per_1000_1to59),
             alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "# deaths/1000", option = "mako", direction = -1)

n_deaths | n_deaths_per1000

```

## Explore relationships between mortality outcomes and person-time, by treatment group

```{r parallel coordinates plots}

par_coords_dat <- df_all %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(isTreated_child, pt_year_1to59, n_deaths_1to59, deaths_per_1000_1to59) %>%
  mutate(row_n = row_number()) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(deaths_per_1000_1to59, n_deaths_1to59), 
               names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
   mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = c("n_deaths_1to59", "deaths_per_1000_1to59"),
                            labels = c("# deaths", "deaths per 1000 py")))

ggplot(data = par_coords_dat) +
  geom_point(aes(x = variable, y = value, color = pt_year_1to59), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(x = variable, y = value, group = row_n, color = pt_year_1to59), alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~isTreated_child, nrow = 2) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Person-years", option = "D", direction = -1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        axis.title.x = element_blank())

ggplot(data = df_all, aes(x = n_deaths_1to59, y = deaths_per_1000_1to59)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = pt_year_1to59), alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Person-years", option = "D", direction = -1) +
  facet_wrap(~isTreated_child, nrow = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(x = "Total deaths", y = "Deaths per 1000 person-years") +
  stat_cor(method = "pearson", 
           label.x = 30, label.y = 10, hjust = 1, vjust = 0,
           size = 4)

```

## District-level summaries of mortality outcomes

```{r district names}

base_map +
  geom_text(data = niger_adm2_sub, aes(x = st_coordinates(st_centroid(geometry))[,1], 
                      y = st_coordinates(st_centroid(geometry))[,2], 
                      label = adm2_name), size = 3)

```


```{r table district effects}

dist_summ %>%
  arrange(ATE) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)

```

Mortality rates are in deaths per 1000 person-years among children aged 1-59 months. ATE = mean mortality rate in treatment group - mean mortality rate in control group, by district.

```{r map district effects, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}

niger_adm2_sub <- niger_adm2_sub %>%
  left_join(dist_summ, by = c("adm2_name" = "district"))

data_mort_control <- base_map +
  geom_sf(data = niger_adm2_sub, aes(fill = MortRateControl), color = NA, size = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_viridis(option = "D", name = "mort rate\ncontrol", limits = c(0, 25), breaks = seq(0, 25, 5), na.value = NA)

data_mort_treat <- base_map +
  geom_sf(data = niger_adm2_sub, aes(fill = MortRateTreatment),
                      color = NA, size = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_viridis(option = "D", name = "mort rate\ntreatment", limits = c(0, 25), breaks = seq(0, 25, 5), na.value = NA)

data_mort_ate <- base_map +
  geom_sf(data = niger_adm2_sub, aes(fill = ATE), color = NA, size = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(name = "ATE", low = muted("dodgerblue"), mid = "white", high = muted("red"), midpoint = 0)

data_mort_control | data_mort_treat | data_mort_ate

```

# Spatial model results

## Mortality predictions from spatial models

```{r simple model predictions}

simp_dat <- ate_preds %>%
  dplyr::filter(model == "gen_krig") %>%
  mutate(lon = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1],
         lat = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2])

simp_pred_ctrl_rast <- points_to_raster(
    x = simp_dat$lon,
    y = simp_dat$lat,
    z = simp_dat$predControl,
    mask1 = niger_adm2_sub,
    crop1 = niger_adm2_sub
  )

simp_pred_ctrl_df <- as.data.frame(simp_pred_ctrl_rast, xy = TRUE) %>%
  drop_na(z)

base_map +
  geom_raster(data = simp_pred_ctrl_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = z))

```
